items.headline: Roll Call: the fiscal 2027 NDAA and the $1.5 trillion defense request are stuck until the lame duck
items.summary: Roll Call reported Oct. 27 that the fiscal 2027 National Defense Authorization Act and full-year Pentagon funding were unresolved when lawmakers left to campaign. It said Democrats have balked at authorizing a record budget and at moving a defense policy bill without guardrails on the Iran war. Roll Call said the administration has requested a $1.15 trillion base budget, $350 billion in a partisan reconciliation bill, and about $60 billion in supplemental funding for Iran-war costs, and that officials including Pete Hegseth are still pushing Republicans for that package. It also said Sen. Mitch McConnell wrote in a Wall Street Journal op-ed that ending what he called obeisance to Putin may be table stakes for the end-of-year legislation.
